name: draw_title_fire_frames
purpose: Selects draw page 1, clears it (put_char 0xff on the current window) and draws ULTIMA.16 images 1..4 (the four 288x49 fire frames) at x=16, y=0,50,100,150 with draw_image mode 0. Page 1 then holds the frame bands that driver entry 35 (title_fire_tick / title_fire_burn) blits into page 0 rows 65..113. Uses the ULTIMA.16 segment kept in 0xbb1a by show_title_screen/show_acknowledgements. Ghidra named it TOWN_81d0 because the vectors 1778:037a/03fe target TOWN's function at the same load address; those vectors never reach INTRO (INTRO-internal callers only).

0xbb1a.name: g_title_pic_seg
0xbb1a.meaning: RAM: heap segment of the loaded ULTIMA.16 title picture

name: trace_path_segment
proto: int trace_path_segment(int y, int x)  /* Ghidra (param_1=y, param_2=x) */
purpose: Animates one segment of the BRITISH.PTH route (loaded by run_intro over the save-game area 0x55a6, 0x1060 bytes) as a dotted trail on the Britannia map. Starting at pixel (x,y) and path index g_intro_path_pos (0xbb18), each path byte b encodes dy = b&7 (negated if b&8) and dx = (b&0x70)>>4 (negated if b&0x80); a magnitude > 2 lifts the pen for that step (the pixel is not plotted), otherwise plot_pixel in g_ui_color1 before moving. Stops at a 0 byte: stores index+1 in 0xbb18 and returns it (nonzero). read_key every step: a key aborts and returns 0. g_cpu_speed is forced to 0x113 during the trace and restored; every 32nd index waits one tick. The loop also ends at index 0x1060 (end of the buffer).

0xbb18.name: g_intro_path_pos
0xbb18.meaning: RAM: current index into the BRITISH.PTH bytes at 0x55a6 (next segment start)

0x55a6.name: g_savegame_area
0x55a6.meaning: save-game image; during the title it holds BRITISH.PTH

0x5356.name: g_cpu_speed
0x5356.meaning: delay unit; set to 0x113 while tracing

notes: The symbols.json type u8 for 0xbb18 is wrong: it is read/written as a 16-bit word.

name: play_story_sequence
purpose: The 'Ultima V Introduction' slideshow (menu key U). Frees the registered picture unless g_location is already '@' and sets g_location='@'. Loads PROPORT.PCS (g_raw_file_names[0]) as the proportional font segment and calls FONT_e1e0("", seg) once, clears both pages, cursor (0,10), loads TEXT.16 (0x260c) and STORY1.16 (0x260e). For screen n = 0..20: if g_story_number[n] differs from the current story file, frees it and loads STORY<g_story_number[n]+1>.16 (name pointer 0x260e+2*k); g_display_mode=2; clears page 1; hook g_story_hook[n]==1 draws TEXT.16 headings (screen 0: image 0 at (224,30) + image 1 at (168,58); 7: image 0 at (232,26) + image 2 at (200,54); 14: image 0 at (184,0) + image 3 at (248,0)); draws story image g_story_image_index[n] at (g_story_pic_x[n], g_story_pic_y[n]) and, when hook>3, image hook*2-5 at y+55; fills the FONT_e1e0 layout block: 0x5146/0x5148 = g_story_left_x[2n],[2n+1], 0x514c/0x514e = g_story_right_x[2n],[2n+1], 0x5150/0x5152 = g_story_para1_y/para2_y, 0x5156 = g_story_first_line_x, 0x5158 = g_story_text_y. Hook 3 (blue door screen): draws image 3 at (96,39), prints 0x2f31 'Instantly, a shimmering blue door springs up!' then sets 0x5158=0xb4 and prints 0x2f5f 'With heart beating rapidly, you step into it.'; otherwise loads 2000 bytes at g_story_text_offsets[n] of STORY.DAT into g_ool_buffer and prints that. Screens after the first wait for a key (flush_keyboard, read_key loop). copy_page(1->0); hook 2 then draws image 2 at (40,86) on page 1 and dissolves it in (rect_effect (40,86)-(75,120)). After screen 20: frees the three blocks, waits for a key, clears page 1, g_display_mode=0, select_disk(0).

0x5893.name: g_location
0x5893.meaning: during the intro: 0x40 '@' = no tile set registered, 0x41 'A' = TILES.16 registered

0x25ea.name: g_raw_file_names
0x25ea.meaning: file-name pointer table; [0] PROPORT.PCS, [17] TEXT.16 (0x260c), [18..23] STORY1..6.16 (0x260e..)

0x30ae.name: g_story_number
0x30ae.meaning: story picture file index per screen

0x30f0.name: g_story_hook
0x30f0.meaning: per-screen special: 1 TEXT.16 heading, 2 dissolve image 2, 3 blue-door text, >3 second image hook*2-5

0x3016.name: g_story_text_offsets
0x3016.meaning: STORY.DAT offset of each screen's text

0x306c.name: g_story_first_line_x
0x306c.meaning: x of the first text line

0x5146.name: g_ptext_left_x
0x5146.meaning: RAM: FONT_e1e0 layout: left x of paragraph 1/2 (0x5146/0x5148)

0x514c.name: g_ptext_right_x
0x514c.meaning: RAM: FONT_e1e0 layout: right x of paragraph 1/2 (0x514c/0x514e)

0x5150.name: g_ptext_para1_y
0x5150.meaning: RAM: FONT_e1e0 layout: y where paragraph 1 ends

0x5152.name: g_ptext_para2_y
0x5152.meaning: RAM: FONT_e1e0 layout: y where paragraph 2 ends

0x5156.name: g_ptext_x
0x5156.meaning: RAM: FONT_e1e0 current x (first line start)

0xb21e.name: g_ool_buffer
0xb21e.meaning: reused as the 2000-byte STORY.DAT paragraph buffer (overruns into the following RAM)

0xa9be.name: g_display_mode
0xa9be.meaning: 2 while showing pictures, 0 at the end

notes: FUN_1778_0566 is the vector to FONT_e1e0(text, font_seg) (proportional text drawer); Ghidra's 'ROOT' attribution is a mis-disassembly of the 12-byte vector. The 2000-byte STORY.DAT read into the 0x200-byte g_ool_buffer overruns to 0xb9ee (harmless at that point).

name: draw_bottom_banner
purpose: Vector 1778:0542 (used by run_intro for 'Copyright 1988 Lord British' and by FONT_e5f8). Draws a centred caption bar on text row 24: with len = strlen(text) and col = 18 - len/2, fills two g_ui_color2 blocks at y 193..199 (x 8..(len/2-18)*-8 and (len+col+2)*8..311), draws a g_ui_color1 line at y=192 over each block, sets the cursor to (col,24) and prints bar-left-cap, the text, bar-right-cap.

name: draw_menu_frame
purpose: Draws the main-menu box under the title: in text colour g_ui_color2 from (0,15) the frame glyphs 0x7b, 38 x 0x7f, 0x7c, then 8 rows of 0x7f at columns 0 and 39, then 0x7d, 38 x 0x7f and 0x7e (the last one printed with g_cursor_advance=0 so the cursor does not wrap); then in g_ui_color1 the pixel rectangle (7,127)-(312,192) with draw_line/draw_line_to; text colour back to g_ui_color1.

0x538e.name: g_cursor_advance
0x538e.meaning: cleared around the last corner glyph

name: show_title_screen
purpose: Shows the 'ULTIMA V' title with the burning letters. g_display_mode=2; frees the picture if g_location!='@' and sets '@'. Loads ULTIMA.16 (0x261e) into g_title_pic_seg (0xbb1a), clears page 0, draws image 0 (319x61 title) at (0,0) on page 1. If animate: rect_effect dissolves rows 0..100 of page 1 into page 0, then animate = (read_key()==0) (a key during the dissolve cancels the rest). If animate is now 0 the rows 0..100 are copied page 1 -> 0 directly. draw_title_fire_frames (page 1), free the picture; if animate: load WD.BIT (0x3105) and run title_fire_burn (driver entry 35 CF=1) with it, free. Then draw page 0, one title_fire_tick, g_display_mode=0 and draw_menu_frame.

name: draw_menu_item
proto: void draw_menu_item(char *text, int col, int index, int selected)  /* Ghidra (text,col,index,selected) */
purpose: Prints one menu line at row 17+index, column col as ' text ' (space, string, space). When index == selected the line is wrapped in 0xfd (inverse video toggle) so it appears highlighted.

name: draw_main_menu
purpose: Draws the six main-menu entries: 'Journey Onward' (col 12), 'Create New Character' (9), 'Transfer from Ultima IV' (8), 'Ultima V Introduction' (9), 'Acknowledgements' (11), 'Return to the View' (10) at rows 17..22, highlighting entry `selected`.

name: show_acknowledgements
purpose: Menu key A. Loads STARTSC.16 (0x2620: image 0 = 16x137 left curtain, 1 = 288x137 credits, 2 = 16x137 right curtain). Draws the credits on page 1 at (16,63); on page 0 stacks the two curtain strips at x=144/160 for y from 199 down to 63 (building a closed curtain), then opens it: for d = 0,8,..,136 draws the left strip at x=136-d and copies the revealed column band (152-d..159-d, rows 63..199) from page 1, draws the right strip at x=168+d and copies 160+d..167+d, one tick per step. Reloads ULTIMA.16 and draws image 1 at (16,65) on page 1 (clearing it first), frees it, draw_menu_frame and draw_main_menu(4); waits for a key; closes the curtain (d from 136 down to 0, mirrored), frees STARTSC.16, then for y = 63..198 redraws the two strips one row lower and copies row y (x 144..175) from page 1 (rolling the curtain seam up), copies row 199, draw_title_fire_frames, page 0, flush_keyboard.
notes: The final strip loop draws from the STARTSC.16 block after it was freed (DOS free leaves the bytes); the port's free_seg also leaves memory intact.

name: wait_key_ticks
purpose: Polls read_key once per timer tick for up to `ticks` ticks (wait_ticks(1) between polls). Returns the key code as soon as one arrives, else 0.

name: run_intro
purpose: Vector 1778:02ae, called once by ROOT main; owns start-up, the title and the main menu, and returns only for 'Journey Onward' with a valid SAVED.GAM. Start-up: g_sound_enabled=1; g_tile_anim_map[i]=i; detect_video_adapter; init_system; Tandy (adapter 2) with g_mem_kb<0x170 -> g_flag_tandy=0, g_force_cga=1, adapter 0; load_video_driver until nonzero; init_graphics_driver(1); adapter 0 (CGA) or 3 (Hercules): every g_raw_file_names entry whose extension starts with '1' is patched in place to '.4' ('.16'->'.4'); otherwise palette words g_ui_color2=1, g_ui_color0=4, g_ui_color1=15, g_ui_color4=5, g_ui_color3=2, g_ui_color_sun=14, g_ui_color_moon=7; driver_init_screen (0 -> restore_video_mode, exit(1)); fonts: Hercules ibm.hcs/runes.hcs else ibm.ch/runes.ch into slots 0/1; select_font(0); window 0 = (0,0)-(39,24). First key: a pending 'J' skips the title: prints 'Journey Onward' centred at row 11, registers TILES.16 (0x25f0), g_location='A', state=0x4a. Else the title: TITLE.BIT (0x25ee) and BRITISH.BIT (0x25ec) loaded raw, BRITISH.PTH read over 0x55a6 (0x1060 bytes), draw_stacked_pictures (entry 37 zoom; state = not aborted), page 1: clear rows 140..199, TITLE.BIT image 7 at (108,140), copy to page 0; if not aborted wait 18 ticks + wait_key_ticks(20); then clear, image 8 at (152,0), copy_page, wait_key_ticks(20); then on page 0 the four trace_path_segment calls (0x2c,0x44) (0x40,0x5e) (0x8f,0x4e) (0xa7,0x69) with g_intro_path_pos reset to 0 (state = last result); BRITISH.BIT image 0 at (24,66), copy_page, TITLE.BIT image 9 at (104,160), copy_page, wait_key_ticks(20) if still running; free both, g_location='@', show_title_screen(state) and, if nothing was pressed, FONT_e684 (the View); state=1. Seeds the RNG from get_time_hash. Menu loop: windows 0 (1,16)-(38,23) cleared then 0=(0,0)-(39,24), 1=(24,1)-(39,9), 2=(24,11)-(39,23); state 0x4a selects 'J' directly, otherwise draw_bottom_banner('Copyright 1988 Lord British'), draw_main_menu(0) and the selection loop: 'Select: ' between caps at (15,15), cursor at (15,23), g_cpu_speed=0x113, up to 200 poll_key_with_cursor polls each followed by title_fire_tick when idle; key 0 (timeout) -> 'R'; Enter/Space -> 'JCTUAR'[sel]; 1/3 (left/up) previous entry, 2/4 (right/down) next (wrapping), other control codes ignored; letters J C T U A R move the highlight to their entry (0..5) and are taken; anything else ignored; loop until key >= 0x21. Dispatch: 'A': free picture (g_location='@'), show_acknowledgements, restart; 'C': FONT_ecea (create character) then the common tail; 'T': clear, transfer_from_ultima4, common tail (window 0 full, clear both pages, show_title_screen(0), draw_title_fire_frames, page 0); 'J': draw_game_frame, set_wind_and_draw(0), window 2 cursor (0,12), register TILES.16 if g_location=='@' (then 'A'), select_disk(3), SAVED.GAM -> 0x55a6 (0x1060); if g_party[0].name[0] != 0: SAVED.OOL (0x200) -> g_ool_buffer, select_disk(1), BRIT.OOL <- 0xb21e (0x100), UNDER.OOL <- 0xb31e (0x100), and if g_location==0 && g_party_z!=0 select_disk(5), wait for UNDER.DAT, UNDER.OOL again; set_wind_and_draw(-1), g_cell_h=8, RETURN. Otherwise 'No active game. Please create a character or transfer one from Ultima IV.', wait_key, g_disk3_drive_letter=0xff, select_disk(0), clear both pages, show_title_screen(0), state=0. 'R': FONT_e684. 'U': play_story_sequence, show_title_screen(0).

0xbb18.name: g_intro_path_pos
0xbb18.meaning: reset to 0 before the path trace

0x5893.name: g_location
0x5893.meaning: '@'/'A' picture state during the intro; game location after SAVED.GAM

0x55a8.name: g_party
0x55a8.meaning: name[0] != 0 means a saved game exists

0x5895.name: g_party_z
0x5895.meaning: nonzero outdoors = Underworld -> UNDER.OOL on disk 5

0x52be.name: g_cell_h
0x52be.meaning: set to 8 before returning to main

0xb21e.name: g_ool_buffer
0xb21e.meaning: SAVED.OOL image; first half BRIT.OOL, second half (0xb31e) UNDER.OOL

notes: FUN_1778_054e is the vector to FONT_ecea (create character); font::FONT_e684 is 'the View' (idle title animation). In the Rust port driver_init_screen cannot fail. The ESC-while-selecting-drive quirk lives in transfer_from_ultima4.

name: load_ultima4_character
purpose: g_display_mode=1, g_cur_disk=4, g_disk_drive_letters[4] = current drive. Reads 0x28 bytes from offset 8 of party.sav (the first Ultima IV character record) into 0xbc88: +0 hp, +2 max hp, +4 exp, +6 str, +8 dex, +0xa int, +0xc mp (u16 each), +0x10 weapon, +0x12 armour, +0x14 name[16], +0x24 sex (0x0b/0x0c), +0x25 class 0..7. Bad if str/dex/int > 70, hp/maxhp/exp > 9999, class > 7, or a control character (< 0x20, non-zero) in the first 8 name bytes: prints 'Error: Your Ultima IV game contains bad data. Unable to continue transfer. Press any key to return to the menu.' centred at row 5, wait_key, returns 1. Else copies up to 8 name characters into g_party[0].name (NUL-terminated), gender 0x0b if the U4 sex byte is 0x0b else 0x0c, class letter by U4 class index (0 M mage, 1 B bard, 2 F fighter, 3 D druid, 4 T tinker, 5 P paladin, 6 R ranger, 7 S shepherd), status 'G', str/dex/int/mp (low bytes), hp, max hp, exp, level = maxhp/100. Then reads party.sav 0x140..0x1f5 into 0xbb1c and sets the Avatar flag 0x3304 = 1 if the eight words at 0xbb22..0xbb30 (file 0x146..0x155: the eight karma counters; 0 = partial avatar in that virtue) are all zero. Returns 0.

0xbc88.name: g_u4_record
0xbc88.meaning: RAM: first Ultima IV party.sav character record (file offset 8)

0x3304.name: g_transfer_is_avatar
0x3304.meaning: DATA.OVL byte pair used as RAM: 1 when the transferred character is a full Avatar

notes: Karma interpretation of 0x146.. is inferred from the U4 save layout (8 records of 39 bytes from offset 8 -> food at 0x140, gold 0x144, karma 0x146); medium confidence on that detail only.

name: print_class_name
purpose: Prints the class name with trailing newline for g_party_class: B Bard, D Druid, F Fighter, M Mage, P Paladin, R Ranger, S Shepherd, T Tinker (strings 0x3306..0x3344). Other letters (e.g. 'A' Avatar) print nothing.

name: convert_u4_stat
purpose: Maps an Ultima IV statistic (range to 50) onto the Ultima V scale (to 30): values <= 9 unchanged; 10..29 -> (v-9)/2 + 10; >= 30 -> (v-30)/4 + 20 (signed division written with a sign mask by the compiler). 50 -> 25, 30 -> 20, 29 -> 20.

name: transfer_from_ultima4
purpose: Menu key T. Saves g_location (turning 'B' into 'A' first), sets disk 3 and 4 drive letters to disk 1's, loads INIT.GAM (0x1060 -> 0x55a6) and INIT.OOL (0x100 -> 0xb31e), full-screen window 0 cleared. set_default_drive(letter) loop: while it fails, wait_key gives a new (upper-cased) letter; Esc restores g_location and returns. g_error_hook = 1000:2322. load_ultima4_character; nonzero -> restore g_location and return. Avatar flag -> g_party_class='A'. Screen 1 (centred text): 'Found:', the name, 'a level N Male/Female Class', STR/DEX/INT at column 17 rows 15..17, '<name> is an Avatar./not an Avatar'; wait_key. Screen 2: setup_transfer_windows (two panels 'Ultima IV' left/right, message window 2) with print_stat_label 0..7 in both; left panel shows name, sex, class/Avatar, exp, level, STR, DEX, INT, 'Avatar'/'Non-Avatar' at row 15. Steps, each highlighting the current label with 0xfd in both panels and prompting in window 2: 'Keep this name?' Y/N (N: 'Enter new name: ' read_line(8) into g_party until non-empty); the right panel gets the name; 'Keep same sex?' Y/N -> Male (0x0b) if (Y and male) or (N and female) else Female (0x0c); class: 'Thou art now an Avatar:' or 'Class remains intact' (wait); exp /= 10 ('Experience has been converted'); level = 1 + number of halvings of exp/100 down to 0, hp = max hp = level*30 ('Level has been converted'); STR = convert_u4_stat, minimum 20 ('Strength: was N(50), now M(30)'); DEX = convert; INT = convert and mp = INT; each with wait_key. Finally the 'Avatar/Non-Avatar' line on the right, window 2 redefined to (2,21)-(37,22), select_disk(3), ' Conversion complete, saving...', zeroes the first 0x100 bytes of g_ool_buffer, writes SAVED.OOL (0x200 from 0xb21e) and SAVED.GAM (0x1060 from 0x55a6), select_disk(0), g_display_mode=0, g_location restored.

0xb21e.name: g_ool_buffer
0xb21e.meaning: first half zeroed, written as SAVED.OOL together with INIT.OOL in the second half

notes: On Esc in the drive loop the original stores the uninitialised SI register into g_location (compiler/Ghidra 'unaff_SI'); the port restores the saved location. Lines like 'STR:' are printed through literal offsets (0x33fa etc.).

name: print_stat_label
purpose: Prints stat label `index` (0..7) at column 3 of row g_stat_label_rows[index] (0x3656: 2,5,6,8,9,11,12,13) using the string pointer g_str_stat_label_ptrs[index] (0x3666 -> '    Name:', '  Sex:', 'Class:', '  Exp:', 'Level:', '  STR:', '  DEX:', '  INT:'), in text window 0 and again in window 1.

0x3656.name: g_stat_label_rows
0x3656.meaning: text row of each transfer-panel label

name: draw_transfer_message_frame
purpose: Like draw_menu_frame but for the transfer screen's message box: glyph frame in g_ui_color2 starting at (0,19) with 3 inner rows (0x7b, 38x0x7f, 0x7c, 3 rows of edge glyphs at columns 0/39, 0x7d, 38x0x7f, 0x7e) and a g_ui_color1 rectangle (7,159)-(312,184); text colour back to g_ui_color1.

name: draw_transfer_stat_box
purpose: Draws one 'Ultima IV' character panel whose left pixel edge is x (0 for the before panel, 168 for the after panel): g_ui_color2 fills (x,0)-(x+6,143), (x+143,0)-(x+151,137) and (x+7,137)-(x+150,143); in the current text window prints '{' + two edge glyphs, bar-left-cap, ' Ultima IV ' in g_ui_color1, bar-right-cap, two edge glyphs and 0x7c on row 0, 0x7d at (0,17) and 0x7e at (18,17); then a g_ui_color1 outline from (x+24,7) left to (x+7,7), down to (x+7,136), across to (x+143,136), up to (x+143,7) and left to (x+128,7) (leaving the caption gap).

name: setup_transfer_windows
purpose: Builds the transfer screen: draw_transfer_message_frame; window 0 = (0,0)-(19,18) (before), window 1 = (21,0)-(39,18) (after), window 2 = (3,21)-(37,21) (prompt line); draws the stat box at x=0 in window 0 and at x=168 in window 1, then blanks cell (12,0) of window 1 (the caption's trailing glyph).

name: title_fire_tick
purpose: Vector 1778:0572 (also called by FONT_e4dc and the menu idle loop). wait_ticks(1) then driver entry 35 (offset 0x69) with CF=0: blits the next 49-row fire frame band from page 1 into page 0 rows 65..113, animating the burning title.
notes: The decompiler shows the call through 'g_drv_entry_off' as s_Large_Shield+1; it is the far call through 0x5350.

name: title_fire_burn
purpose: Driver entry 35 with CF=1 and AX = segment of the loaded WD.BIT (288x49 1-bpp mask): the burning-title dissolve that re-reveals page 1 through the mask in LFSR order with fire frames and crackle sound; a pending key aborts. The port calls engine::effects::title_fire_dissolve.
